name: Revolution
author: superhac
description: A desktop and cab theme with a wheel carousel, the table's playfield and the features it ships with.
change_log: Rebuilt for VPinFE 3.0: core now handles input, audio, preloading, layout, the loading indicator, attract mode and the backglass and score view pages, so the theme is one playfield page. The wheel slides one step at a time and cuts when a page jumps. Start on Collection Selection keeps its key.
